rootCause: Fei Labs, the development team of the decentralized stablecoin project Fei Protocol, tweeted that a vulnerability involving the ETH joint curve contract was discovered and disclosed on May 2 and the contract was immediately suspended. The vulnerability has not been exploited and will not affect any users. . This loophole will cause the flash loan market manipulation to exhaust Fei Protocol's Protocol Control Fund (PCV). In addition, Fei Protocol awarded the vulnerability discoverer Alexander Schlindwein a $800,000 TRIBE token reward.
